Learn How to Create a KDP Book Cover in Canva with this easy, step-by-step tutorial! Perfect for authors and self-publishers, this video walks you through the entire design process using Canva's free tools. Create a professional and eye-catching book cover that will make your book stand out on Amazon. No design experience needed! Watch the video for valuable tips and tricks, and don't forget to like, subscribe, and hit the notification bell for more helpful tutorials and self-publishing advice

Step 1: Determine Your Book Cover Size

For a KDP book cover, the standard sizes are:
6 x 9 inches for a notebook
8.5 x 11 inches for a coloring book
To get the exact dimensions, we'll use the KDP Cover Calculator. Here’s how: https://kdp.amazon.com/cover-calculator

Select your book's binding type (e.g., Paperback, Black & White, White paper, Inches).
Enter the trim size (e.g., 6 x 9 inches).
Enter the page count.
Click 'Calculate dimensions' to get the exact measurements for your book cover.

Download the template provided to use as a guide in Canva.


Step 2:  Create kdp cover in canva

Go to Canva and click on 'Create a design', then 'Custom size'.
Enter the dimensions from the KDP Cover Calculator and click 'Create new design'.

Upload the KDP template by clicking on 'Uploads' in the left sidebar, then 'Upload files'. Select the template and upload it.
Drag the template onto your blank canvas and resize it to fit perfectly. This template will guide you to ensure your cover meets KDP's specifications.
Start designing your cover. Use the guides to keep all elements within the safe zones.

Once satisfied with your design, click the 'Share' button in the top right corner, then 'Download'.

Choose 'PDF Print' for the best quality, select the 'CMYK' color profile, and click 'Download'. Save the file to your computer.

Now you're all set to upload your book cover to KDP! Enjoy designing, and let me know in the comments if you have any questions. Happy creating!
